name: Sales (example)
description: Example plugin page with generated sales data, a refresh operation shared by the page and the agent, live updates, and in-page analysis.

operations.name: refresh_data
operations.description: Regenerate the latest sales figures for this project's Sales page and return the updated report. Optional region filter.

operations.name: get_report
operations.description: Return the current sales report for this page, optionally filtered by region.

operations.name: set_target
operations.description: Set the monthly revenue target used for attainment. This changes stored page data and requires user approval when requested by the agent.
